channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Hamidou Diallo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Hamidou Diallo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Hamidou Diallo
item.description:
Casey on the Diallo ejection:

“The explanation I got is he thought he was upset with him from the prior play going into that. I'm not a mind reader, but that's what he felt when Hami ran into him. I thought it was totally accidental.”

Dwane Casey on Hamidou Diallo, Feb 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Hamidou Diallo
item.description:
James Edwards III:Troy Weaver on Hamidou Diallo:

“He fits what we're trying to do here. Tremendous mindset, competitor, defensive mindset and athletic. He brings it.”

Troy Weaver on Hamidou Diallo, Mar 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Hamidou Diallo
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey on Diallo:

“He has a little bit of a hip issue. It will be about how he feels about that. I think he'll be OK from a protocol standpoint. Hip issue might take a little more time.”

Dwane Casey on Hamidou Diallo, Mar 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on Hamidou Diallo
item.description:
Lu Dort on Hamidou Diallo:

“It’s tough. Hami and I were really close. He’s a friend of mine. I wish him well.”

Luguentz Dort on Hamidou Diallo, Mar 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Hamidou Diallo
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Daigneault on Hamidou Diallo:

“There was an edge and a competitiveness. He brought a style of play to the game that can be really good for us.”

Mark Daigneault on Hamidou Diallo, Dec 20, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Hamidou Diallo
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Daigneault on Hamidou Diallo:

“He’s had momentum since the hiatus. This is who he’s been. He plays hard. He’s always around the ball. The effort snd the energy and his ability to impact the game isn’t a question.”

Mark Daigneault on Hamidou Diallo, Dec 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Hamidou Diallo
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Daigneault on Hamidou Diallo:

“He's had a really good camp. I think the momentum he had from the hiatus to The Bubble, he's kept that up. He's done a really good job for us.”

Mark Daigneault on Hamidou Diallo, Dec 12, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.
